klaim.catatan: Semua angka cocok; multi-view R2 = 0,90 dan 101,4% pada h. 13. Label M4 sesuai (asosiasi geometri epipolar dari pose GPS/INS, lalu triangulasi). Persentase dihitung terhadap hitungan panen 16 pohon (Gambar 10); hitungan di pohon dan saat panen keduanya tersedia (Tabel 1).

klaim.bukti: The proposed multi-view approach had high precision (R2 = 0.90) and also high accuracy, counting 101.4% of the fruit (a 1.4% over-count).
klaim.catatan: 27%, 54%, dan 101,4% cocok; 16 pohon cocok. Acuan persentase adalah hitungan tangan saat panen (harvest count), bukan hitungan di pohon.

klaim.bukti: counting only 27% of the fruit that was actually there. The dual-view method had the highest precision (R2 = 0.94), but was also inaccurate, counting 54% of the fruit (double the single-view count).
klaim.catatan: Bagian yang diatribusikan ke kajian ini (27% satu sisi, 54% dua sisi, mangga) cocok.

klaim.bukti: Specifically, the dual-view output can be calibrated by dividing by the slope of 0.54 (from Figure10b). The multi-view estimate had a similarly precise relationship to yield (R2 = 0.90), but was much more accurate with a near unity slope of 1.014.
klaim.catatan: R2 0,94 lawan 0,90 cocok. Pembagian dengan 0,54 setara faktor pengali 1,85, sehingga 'near two' dapat diterima.

klaim.bukti: The dual-view method had the highest precision (R2 = 0.94), but was also inaccurate, counting 54% of the fruit (double the single-view count).
klaim.catatan: Cocok untuk bagian Stein dkk.: R2 dual 0,94 lebih tinggi daripada single 0,81 dan multi-view 0,90. Bagian Anderson dkk. tidak dinilai di sini.

klaim.bukti: A total of 522 trees and 71,609 mangoes were scanned [...] only the proposed multi-view approach can do so without calibration, with an error rate of only 1.36% for individual trees.
klaim.catatan: Semua unsur cocok dengan abstrak (korespondensi dari trajektori navigasi, triangulasi, masker LiDAR per pohon, 522 pohon, 71.609 mangga, 1,36%). Catatan: 1,36% berasal dari kemiringan regresi 1,0136 atas 16 pohon tervalidasi (h. 13 dan 19), yaitu bias agregat, bukan galat tiap pohon; 71.609 adalah jumlah setelah dikoreksi dengan kemiringan itu (h. 16).

klaim.bukti: in this research, we split a video into frames to obtain eight-sided images; thus, the total frames were divided by eight, and then eight were obtained. Then, the frame in the east is the first frame
klaim.perbaikan: Qualify the mango example: "...or the eight-sided mango protocol of [nenavath2024tree], in which eight frames are sampled at equal intervals from a clockwise walk-around video, ...". The eight retained views are widely separated, but they come from an ordered video sequence, so state that M3 does not apply to the retained frames rather than that the acquisition has no temporal order.
klaim.catatan: Protokol delapan sisi dan mangga cocok. Namun delapan citra bukan foto lepas: citra diambil dari video 360 derajat searah jarum jam (45-75 s, sekitar 30 fps) yang dipecah menjadi frame, lalu dipilih delapan frame berurutan arah. Pernyataan 'no temporal order' tidak tepat untuk kajian ini; hitungan ganda dihindari dengan mengurangi 'corner mango' (Pers. 5), bukan dengan asosiasi.

klaim.bukti: eight exact images of the tree based on eight directions, such as east, south, west, north, south-east, south-west, north-east, and north-west, will give only eight frames.
klaim.catatan: Pencitraan mangga multi-sisi dari delapan arah tetap cocok. Catatan: dalam eksperimen, delapan citra itu diperoleh dari frame video keliling pohon, bukan dari pemotretan terpisah.
